title: Nested Links on a Bending Guide
description: A docs sidebar whose Nav has $guide set to smooth: a guide runs before the links of each NavGroup and bends into the nested NavList of a NavItem, whose links always show. The nested lists set $marker to bullet, which draws a dot on the guide at each nested link. The bar prop draws the bar of the current link on the guide, and it fills the dot of a nested link. Use it for a page tree with a few levels that stay open, rather than NavDisclosure sections that collapse.
